attempts.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 over their shared transit network (10.100.250.0/24), routing node3's private lan-a subnet (10.10.1.0/24) and node4's private lan-b subnet (10.10.2.0/24) across it. node3 and node4 now reach each other by private address, with the transit link carrying only encrypted WireGuard UDP traffic. Verified with a mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all 4 nodes, confirming boot-identity change and full recovery of tunnel, routes, and connectivity after each.
